sentences.text: The documents do not state a maximum penal charge in rupees for one missed EMI; they say a UCB may charge penal charges only on the amount under default, and those charges must be reasonable.
The documents also say additional / fresh penal charges shall not be levied on the earlier outstanding amount of penal charges, and there is no capitalization of the penal charges.
The superseded 2023 rules likewise say the quantum of penal charges shall be reasonable and commensurate, and they do not give a rupee cap.
